<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Remove all 9 green blocks on this screen
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Found {len(greens)} green blocks")

clicks = []
for g in greens:
    gc = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
    gr = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
    center_r = (min(gr) + max(gr)) // 2
    center_c = (min(gc) + max(gc)) // 2
    clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})

# Execute all clicks
for click in clicks:
    result = action([click])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    remaining = len([n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N'])
    done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done')
    print(f"Click ({click['row']},{click['col']}): greens={remaining}, done={done}")
    if done:
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break

# If still not done, check state
if not done:
    print(f"\nAfter removing all: {remaining} greens, done={done}")
    # Check walls
    walls = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
    print(f"Walls: {len(walls)}, total px={sum(w['pixels'] for w in walls)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
